name: V8 swap kit (Kaze GT)
_note: Engine mounts, a crossmember, headers and wiring to put the Brute 500's 5.0 L V8 in the Kaze GT: twice the torque, 75 kg more over the front wheels. It needs an uprated clutch (race), gearbox and radiator fitted first; then take the engine out and put the new one in.
